summary: Killing Floor entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Killing Floor
entries.definitive_edition: Current Steam PC release with DLC/mod/server state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC build with exact DLC, server, mod, and perk state documented

primary.version: Current Steam PC release with DLC/mod/server state documented
primary.why: The PC release is the original and best archive route for Killing Floor's co-op survival, mods, mutators, custom maps, and community servers. The original Unreal Tournament 2004 mod and later console/Mac/Linux routes are useful context but should be labeled separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC release. Record build, DLC/character/weapon ownership, map, perk, difficulty, mutators, mods, server, player count, online availability, and whether the UT2004 mod was compared.

secondary.why: The 2009 standalone PC game is the archive target.
Windows PC is the main capture and community route.

all_releases.fidelity: Standalone co-op shooter route with best mod/server support.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Mods, DLC, community servers, and UT2004 mod lineage all need separate labeling.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Killing Floor 2 or the original UT2004 mod.
